propositions: A new CLI flag `rebar review-plan --retry` resumes only the latest eligible INDETERMINATE review by reusing checkpointed findings from successful/resumed units and recomputing missing (failed/cancelled/shed) units under a fresh per-invocation attempt budget.

Retry eligibility requires the latest REVIEW_RESULT to have a versioned discovery_journal that is current (recomputed identity-digest set matches present material/policy/prompts/contracts/model/mode/topology/context/dependencies/source); stale, missing, corrupt, or legacy journals are refused before any model call.

Reused unit content is reconstructed from chunk-atomic CheckpointEnvelope objects by recomputing each unit's checkpoint_identity and loading its stored findings; units with changed material/policy/etc. or missing envelopes are treated as missing and re-run.

Pass-2 verification, coaching, deterministic decision, assembly, and signature eligibility run only over newly recovered findings plus reused results; the combined result determines final verdict and exit code (exit 2 for ineligible refusal, matching non-runnable review-plan behavior).
`--retry` is mutually exclusive with `--force`, `--status`, and `--check`; remains compatible with `--no-sign`; is CLI/library operator affordance with no MCP tool surface or CI-provider dependency.

Documentation updates canonical `review-plan --help`, generated CLI reference, user guide, plan-review gate guide, and exit-code guide to explain eligibility, fresh budget, reuse/refusal, zero-call behavior, flag interactions, and the normal full-review remedy.
